Name: Krobus to Puro
Author: Kotyarendj
Description:
[DEPRECATED, see details on sticked post]

My first Content Patcher Mod that changes all Krobus sprites to custom-made Puro sprites, no texts [i]changed[/i](I tried replacing text, everything broke)
Puro is deuteragonist in the game Changed(Which is really suggestive game, I know) and I really liked how they were similar to each other, so I cooked something right there.

The changes include:
- Portraits
- Character itself
- Cutscene sprites
- Related objects(Iridium Krobus and Krobus painting(Bugged))

Some things might look weird, like Puro half floating mid air, but that's the issue in the main game too, so I don't really know how to fix it.
